component.name: WebBrowser

Label.text: OK: Play/Pause | UP/DOWN: Browse Channels | LEFT: Channel List | BACK: Exit

component.script:
function init() m.currentUrl = m.top.findNode("currentUrl") m.pageTitle = m.top.findNode("pageTitle") m.isLoading = m.top.findNode("isLoading") m.videoPlayer = m.top.findNode("videoPlayer") m.contentLabel = m.top.findNode("contentLabel") m.urlDisplay = m.top.findNode("urlDisplay") m.loadingLabel = m.top.findNode("loadingLabel") m.channelList = m.top.findNode("channelList") m.channels = [] m.currentChannelIndex = 0 m.showChannels = false m.top.observeField("currentUrl", m.port) m.videoPlayer.observeField("state", m.port) end function
function loadChannels(channels as Object) as void m.channels = channels updateChannelList() end function
function playChannel(index as Integer) as void if index >= 0 and index < m.channels.count() m.currentChannelIndex = index channel = m.channels[index] m.pageTitle.value = channel.title loadContent(channel.url, channel.title) end if end function
function onPortMessage() as void msg = wait(0, m.port) if type(msg) = "roSGNodeEvent" field = msg.getField() if field = "currentUrl" loadContent(m.currentUrl.value, "") else if field = "state" and msg.getNode().id = "videoPlayer" handleVideoStateChange(m.videoPlayer.state) end if end if end function
function loadContent(url as String, title as String) as void if url = "" then return if not isValidUrl(url) showError("Invalid URL format: " + url) return end if m.isLoading.value = true m.loadingLabel.visible = true m.contentLabel.text = "Loading: " + title + "..." m.urlDisplay.text = title playVideo(url, title) end function
function isValidUrl(url as String) as Boolean lowerUrl = lcase(url) return url.left(7) = "http://" or url.left(8) = "https://" or lowerUrl.instr("m3u") > 0 end function
function playVideo(url as String, title as String) as void m.videoPlayer.visible = true m.contentLabel.visible = false m.channelList.visible = false m.videoPlayer.content = createVideoContent(url, title) m.videoPlayer.control = "play" m.videoPlayer.setFocus(true) m.isLoading.value = false m.loadingLabel.visible = false end function
function createVideoContent(url as String, title as String) as Object content = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") content.url = url content.title = if(title <> "", title, "Stream") content.streamFormat = "auto" return content end function
function updateChannelList() as void items = [] for each channel in m.channels item = { title: channel.title, description: channel.url } items.push(item) end for m.channelList.content = createListContent(items) end function
function createListContent(items as Object) as Object content = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for each item in items node = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") node.title = item.title node.description = item.description content.appendChild(node) end for return content end function
function handleVideoStateChange(state as String) as void if state = "error" showError("Video playback error - Stream may be unavailable") else if state = "finished" m.videoPlayer.visible = false m.contentLabel.visible = true m.contentLabel.text = "Channel finished. Use UP/DOWN to select another channel or LEFT to browse." end if end function
function showError(message as String) as void m.contentLabel.text = "Error: " + message m.contentLabel.visible = true m.videoPlayer.visible = false m.isLoading.value = false m.loadingLabel.visible = false end function
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false
if key = "left" m.showChannels = not m.showChannels m.channelList.visible = m.showChannels if m.showChannels and m.channels.count() > 0 m.channelList.setFocus(true) end if return true else if key = "up" if m.showChannels if m.channelList.hasFocus() m.channelList.moveUp() end if else if m.currentChannelIndex > 0 playChannel(m.currentChannelIndex - 1) end if end if return true else if key = "down" if m.showChannels if m.channelList.hasFocus() m.channelList.moveDown() end if else if m.currentChannelIndex < m.channels.count() - 1 playChannel(m.currentChannelIndex + 1) end if end if return true else if key = "OK" if m.showChannels and m.channelList.hasFocus() playChannel(m.channelList.jumpToItem) m.showChannels = false m.channelList.visible = false return true else if m.videoPlayer.visible and m.videoPlayer.hasFocus() if m.videoPlayer.paused m.videoPlayer.control = "play" else m.videoPlayer.control = "pause" end if return true end if end if return false end function
